title: myroxylon claraense
intro: Myroxylon claraense, commonly known as Palo Santo, is a plant species native to South America, particularly in Ecuador and Peru. This plant is known for its fragrant wood and has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and alleviate respiratory issues. The health benefits of Palo Santo include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing anxiety and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Palo Santo include sesquiterpenes, such as alpha-pinene and beta-pinene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and distinctive aroma.
